description: Keep a result you just produced in your account, by its screening_id, so you can list it, reopen it and verify it later. Works for a screening or memo made by this account in the last 15 minutes; after that, run it again. The free test addresses produce test results, which cannot be saved. Saving the same result twice does nothing the second time. Scoped to your account: needs sign-in (/mcp/account) or an API key. Free.

case_reference.description: Optional case reference to file the saved result under.

screening_id.description: The screening_id of a result this account produced in the last 15 minutes (from the result's provenance).

name: saved_results_save

outputSchema.description: Structured response for saving a result: the screening_id, the tool, the case reference and when the copy expires.

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

caseReference.description: Case reference it is filed under.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when the tool fails.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

retentionDays.description: How long the account keeps saved results.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

tool.description: The tool that made the result.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.
